id: title:jonmcwest:point the empty logs state at drop rules

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a settings page link and contextual help for configuring log drop rules, potentially improving user configuration and retention.
review.reason: The change adds an import and usage of a URL helper for the drop rules settings page, and replaces a documentation link with a flex container including that settings link. This connects the empty-state UI and documentation to a configuration action, allowing users to configure why logs were removed. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of this configuration change and its impact on user behavior or retention is not demonstrated by the code; this is a potential benefit, not an observed outcome.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are supplied; no other hunks. No score assigned.
